Subject: Urgent: production latency spike — requesting MAP checkpoint + exec sponsor involvement

Hi Markus,

We hit a repeated latency spike in our prod cluster overnight (12/03) that pushed response times above the 99th percentile SLA in two of our customer-facing endpoints. Our SREs collected logs and traces — attaching a zip with the snapshots (incident-logs-1203.zip). 

This is impacting a pilot we are running ahead of our commercial close next week (MAP milestone: performance validation). Our executive sponsor Ravi asked me to escalate so we can get a short executive-bridge and an updated MAP status with ownership on mitigation.

Can your team stand up an immediate checkpoint (30–45min) today to triage and agree on mitigation + close timeline adjustments? Ravi is available for a 10:30 PST bridge today.

Appreciate the quick help — this is blocking our go/no-go for the pilot tomorrow.

Thanks,
Sarah Lin

Acme Corp

- Short memo for exec review with timeline + impact (who was affected, how long, estimated business impact)

Subject: MAP checkpoint notes (12/08) — resolution, action items, and owner commitments

Team / Ravi — following this week's bridge and the on-call remediation, here's a concise checkpoint and next steps aligned to the MAP so Acme can complete validation and we can keep the deal on track.

Summary:
- Incident: 12/03–12/04 intermittent 99th percentile latency spikes on inference gateway. Root cause (prelim): a recent routing patch that increased requests hitting a long-tail model variant under high-concurrency.
- Current state: INC-7821 shows mitigation applied (temporary routing rollback + extended logging). Post-mitigation 99th percentile latency has returned to SLA target in our internal tests. No customer-facing errors reported since 12/05 03:10 PST.

Key action items and owners (MAP-aligned):
- Monica: Confirm closure checklist for INC-7821 and upload collected logs to the shared incident folder (due: 2026-12-09 12:00 PST).
- Sean: Deliver a short runbook with temporary routing knobs we used and automated fallback thresholds (deliverable: runbook.md — due: 2026-12-10).
- Lauren: Update MAP_v2 acceptance criteria to include an additional perf-validation step for the pilot (due: 2026-12-11).
- Marissa: Draft an executive memo summarizing impact and recommended customer concession (deliverable: exec_memo.pdf — due: 2026-12-09).
- Markus / Aditya: Confirm whether a one-time pilot credit (per existing SLA language) is appropriate after impact tally and legal review (target decision date: 2026-12-12).

Status and notes:
- Procurement question on credit mechanics: Marissa/Markus will send clause references and short summary by 12/06 (marissa: assigned).
- Customer-facing next step: Acme to continue pilot validation tomorrow; Redwood will provide the runbook and confirm stability metrics by 12/11.

Attachments included: weekly-map-notes-20261208.pdf (checkpoint notes), INC-7821-log-tail.txt (relevant log tail).

I'll schedule a 15-minute exec check-in for next Monday to confirm the final remediation sign-off and any commercial concessions. Thanks everyone for the quick turnaround.

— Markus Klein
